title: Revolts Pagal Panthis
definition: A semi-religious, peasant-led agrarian uprising in the Mymensingh district of Bengal (1825–1835) against the oppressive taxation and exploitation by the British colonial administration and local zamindars.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the transition from religious-reformist movements to militant peasant resistance in early 19th-century colonial India.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Revolts Pagal Panthis.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
